name: codex-lid-guard
description: Keeps Windows awake while a local Codex turn runs, even with the laptop lid closed, then restores sleep behavior.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run build:helper
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o codex-lid-guard.vsix

commands.title: Codex Lid Guard: Toggle Message Overlay
Codex Lid Guard: Preview Message Overlay
Codex Lid Guard: Disable and Restore Power Settings
Codex Lid Guard: Restore Power Settings Now
Codex Lid Guard: Enable Optional Hook Alerts
Codex Lid Guard: Test Alert Sounds

codexLidGuard.messageOverlay.description: Show the latest assistant updates whenever another app or chat is in focus. Hide only the chat currently visible in its focused VS Code window. Hover over a tab to expand it; move away to tuck it back. Double-click a message to maximize VS Code and open its chat. Reads newly appended assistant display messages from local Codex session files; previews stay in memory.

codexLidGuard.overlayOpacity.description: Message overlay opacity, as a percentage. Lower values are more transparent.

codexLidGuard.overlayDurationSeconds.description: How long older message previews are retained. The latest update from each of the three most recent chats stays available when you switch away from that chat. Long messages are shortened.

codexLidGuard.overlayPosition.description: Corner of the originating VS Code window's display used for message previews.

codexLidGuard.alertSounds.description: Play Herdr-style alerts when a Codex task completes or needs your response.

codexLidGuard.alertSoundsOnlyWhenUnfocus.description: Play automatic alerts only when the task's Codex chat is not current or its editor window is minimized or no longer in the foreground. The manual sound test always plays.

codexLidGuard.enabled.description: Monitor local Codex turns and guard the laptop while they run. No Codex hook setup is required.

codexLidGuard.optionalHooks.description: Optionally install Codex hooks for immediate approval/request alerts and redundant lifecycle signals. Codex requires a one-time manual trust review when this is enabled.

codexLidGuard.sleepWhenLidClosed.description: Put Windows to sleep after the final active Codex turn finishes if the lid is still closed.

codexLidGuard.sleepDelaySeconds.description: Grace period before sleeping after a task finishes with the lid closed. A new turn cancels the pending sleep.
